name: MMI Subscriptions
excerpt: A self-contained subscription engine for WooCommerce: recurring billing, renewals, switching and payment retries.
intro: MMI Subscriptions adds recurring products to WooCommerce without another subscription extension. Customers subscribe at checkout and manage their subscriptions from My Account. Renewals bill automatically through a payment gateway that supports WooCommerce subscription renewals, such as Stripe.

features.text: Plan switching and early renewal, when you turn them on
Customer pages for My Account, including Bricks elements
Sell a one-time option beside recurring plans, like a lifetime license next to yearly ones
Checkout shows what's due today and what each subscription bills after, with its start date
Allow more than one subscription in an order; each one bills on its own schedule

requirements: WordPress 6.4+, WooCommerce 8.0+, PHP 8.0+. Don’t run it alongside WooCommerce Subscriptions.

screenshots.title: Subscription details
screenshots.caption: Everything about one subscription on a single screen.
features: Status, customer, recurring total, payment method and length at the top, with the renewal charge including tax
Line items with tax and the renewal total
Every related order, parent and renewals, with its created and paid dates and its status

screenshots.title: Subscription notes
screenshots.caption: A running log of what happened to a subscription, and when.

Add your own note, or tick Send to customer to email it to them

screenshots.title: All subscriptions

features: Filter by Pending, Active, On Hold, Cancelled, Pending Cancellation, Expired or Switched
Next payment, recurring total, payment method and start date for each subscription

screenshots.title: Subscription product settings
screenshots.caption: Sell any product as a subscription from WooCommerce's Product data box.
features: A subscription price with its billing interval and period
Stop renewing after a set length, or renew until cancelled
An optional sign-up fee and free trial
Sale price, tax status and tax class work as they do for any product
